intended_object: The currying map Ω^N X x → Ω(Ω^{N∖{i}} X x): an N-cube map p : I^N → X that sends the boundary to x becomes a loop t ↦ (y ↦ p(insertAt i (t, y))) in the space of generalized loops indexed by N∖{i}, based at the constant map. The docstring says so, and the module uses it as the forward direction of `GenLoop.loopHomeo`.
explanation:
The body is the correct map. Fix t in I. The map y ↦ p(insertAt i (t, y)) is continuous because it is a curried continuous map. It is a generalized loop on I^{N∖{i}}: if y lies on the boundary of that cube, then insertAt i (t, y) lies on the boundary of I^N, so p sends it to x.

The loop starts and ends at the constant generalized loop. At t = 0 or t = 1 the point insertAt i (t, y) has i-th coordinate 0 or 1, so it lies on the boundary of I^N and p sends it to x.

This is the standard identification Ω^n X ≅ Ω(Ω^{n-1} X) behind the group structure on πₙ. It is stated for an arbitrary index type N with decidable equality and an arbitrary topological space X, so it is not too narrow. The map is canonical and is used as the forward map of the homeomorphism `GenLoop.loopHomeo`, so it is not just an internal implementation detail.
